WITH date_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2 AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
),
hd_filtered AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk 
    FROM household_demographics 
    WHERE hd_buy_potential IN ('1001-5000', '5001-10000') AND hd_vehicle_count > 0 AND hd_dep_count > hd_vehicle_count
),
ss_pre_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, COUNT(*) cnt 
    FROM store_sales 
    JOIN date_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
    JOIN hd_filtered ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd_filtered.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_store_sk IN (SELECT s_store_sk FROM store WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County')
    GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number, cnt 
FROM customer 
JOIN ss_pre_agg ON customer.c_customer_sk = ss_pre_agg.ss_customer_sk 
WHERE cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5 
ORDER BY cnt DESC, c_last_name ASC
